passes.name: Fresh compact circulation and boarding connection
Glazed pavilion, gallery and supported stair
Two tactile security lanes and real scanner tunnels
Dense gate seating, café and retail
Forecourt, planted surroundings and working airfield
Pickup props, baggage handling and safety tools
Passengers, player pilots, signs and glazing mechanisms
Local practical lights and daylight contrast

zones.title: ENTRANCE FOYER
zones.description: A public arrival space with a view toward check-in. A broad side opening leads to the desks; the north side joins the landside corridor. Space to orient and meet people.

zones.title: CHECK-IN HALL
zones.description: Staffed desks, bag-drop recesses and contained queues sit off public circulation. After check-in, leave through the offset north opening into the landside corridor.

zones.title: PUBLIC ARRIVALS RETURN
zones.description: A separate passage from reclaim to the forecourt, with trolley parking in edge bays.

zones.title: LANDSIDE CORRIDOR
zones.description: A 4 m deep connector gives breathing room between check-in and security. The security entrance is offset from the check-in exit; information and preparation signs occur before the turn.

zones.title: SECURITY
zones.description: An enclosed section for preparation, two screening lanes, scanning and collection. Enter from the south and leave through a controlled east exit, out of the gate lounges sightline.

zones.title: RECOMPOSURE
zones.description: A 4 m wide recovery vestibule after screening, with benches and bag-repacking ledges. Its concourse opening is offset from the screening exit, creating a pause before the larger airside space.

zones.title: AIRSIDE CONCOURSE
zones.description: A 6 m wide circulation spine serves several branches. Walk along it, choose a destination, then approach a gate, the café or amenities. Furniture and displays occupy edge recesses.

zones.title: A07 APPROACH
zones.description: A recessed pocket beside the concourse. Enter near its north end, pass the A07 marker, then turn toward the lounge through an offset opening. Keep this transition generous and open.

zones.title: A07 / GATE LOUNGE
zones.description: A waiting destination with framed glazing and side screens, its own seating, charging ledges, display and boarding desk. The existing boarding exit still connects to the jetbridge.

zones.title: A08 APPROACH
zones.description: A separate recessed approach branches from the same concourse, with its own gate marker and offset lounge opening.

zones.title: A08 / GATE LOUNGE
zones.description: A second waiting destination reached from its own branch. Glazed partitions, flight identity and seating orientation establish the gate. A07 and A08 do not open into one another.

zones.title: CAFÉ APPROACH
zones.description: A frontage off the concourse, with a menu visible before the turn into the café. Use an open framed corner, with space to pause.

zones.title: CAFÉ / GALLERY
zones.description: A furnished café destination off a side branch. The lower café and gallery remain a feature; stair and counter positions need adjustment to these revised boundaries.

zones.title: WC PASSAGE
zones.description: A 3 m wide passage leaves the south end of the concourse and leads to the lavatories. Toilet doors stay away from lounge seating and boarding queues.

zones.title: WC / ASSISTANCE
zones.description: Enclosed facilities reached from the amenities passage, with doors set back from circulation.

zones.title: ARRIVALS / RECLAIM
zones.description: A reclaim destination with a public exit into the arrivals return passage. Its route stays outside screened departures.

zones.title: STAFF / OPERATIONS
zones.description: A staff service strip behind security, separated from the passenger route. No public shortcut through screening.

focus: Solid internal boundaries, calm sightlines and a single generation of ceiling fixtures

lighting33.style: bright warm welcoming; fixtures plus soft ambient

bridge.interlock: No occupied bridge; L1 fully closed; terminal doors closed before retraction; all moving parts stowed before departure

source_sweep.method: conservative complete-aircraft AABB swept continuously along source -Y

parking.physics: sleep while unoccupied; wake before drive/tow; brake to rest before sleep

departure.prototype_flight: interlock API; no fabricated airport flight controller
